purpose: Diagnostic-only re-run of the frozen FVD053 anchor over the same verified Hyperliquid+OKX overlap window as FVD-EXPLORATORY-002, using corrected candle coverage through the exit hour and persistent missing-candle attribution. It tests whether the 50 candle-stage signal drops recorded by FVD-EXPLORATORY-002 were a data-coverage/alignment artifact rather than an economic result. It does not modify frozen artifacts and does not promote, replace, or unlock any confirmatory track.

estimand.description: Same as FVD-EXPLORATORY-002: cross-venue funding-dispersion carry over the verified Hyperliquid+OKX historical overlap, using the frozen FVD053 anchor (24h dispersion lookback, 80th-percentile prior-90-day threshold, 24h hold, top-10% cross-sectional tail, at least 2 eligible venues). This run changes only data-retrieval coverage and diagnostic persistence; signal selection, thresholds, timing, and accounting are unchanged.
estimand.distinct_from_confirmatory: FVD-DISPERSION-V1 (market-cap-weighted universe) and FVD-EXPLORATORY-001/002/003 remain frozen. This is a separately versioned exploratory diagnostic run, not a new confirmatory hypothesis.
estimand.exploratory_only_reason: Contract identity remains candidate-level (symbol-mapped only), the window is ~97 days versus the >=3-year confirmatory requirement, and no independent audit or sealed holdout exists.

anchor_result: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY, NOT A PERFORMANCE CLAIM. The frozen FVD053 anchor was exercised over the identical FVD-EXPLORATORY-002 window (2026-07-20T00:00Z to 2026-10-25T16:00Z) with candle data fetched through the exit hour. Result: 97 daily signal dates, 180 threshold-eligible underlying-dates, 23 dates with a selected signal, 0 signals dropped for missing entry/exit candles, and 0 dropped for missing funding. Per-venue 1h candle coverage is complete: 2369/2369 expected hourly slots for each of 5 underlyings on each of 2 venues (0 missing, 0 duplicates). This confirms that the 50 candle-stage drops in FVD-EXPLORATORY-002 were a candle coverage/exit-hour alignment artifact, not an economic finding. The 23 signals are descriptive accounting output only; they are not an independently audited backtest, no uncertainty is estimable (overlapping 24h episodes), and no performance metric is claimed.

cost_assumptions.note: frozen grid base scenario; sensitivity assumption, not a venue fee claim

sample_construction: Verified historical intersection of 5 underlyings with funding settlements + 1h price history on 2 venues; no market-cap rank; shorter history than the >=3-year confirmatory requirement; contract identity by underlying symbol only.

coverage_summary.okx_funding_retention_note: OKX funding-rate-history returned a single page with stop_reason=page_not_full, consistent with the rolling ~3-month retention verified by the committed probes; the first OKX settlement inside this window is therefore later than the window start, which is why 31 dates have no cross-venue dispersion.

threshold_history_eligibility.note: The 90-day lookback and 30-observation floor are applied unchanged. 61 dates are structurally threshold-ineligible because OKX funding does not yet cover enough prior daily observations; this is reported, not relaxed.

data_gate_result: PARTIAL — funding + complete 1h price history verified for both venues over the ~97-day window; contract identity symbol-only/unverified; short history versus the 3-year confirmatory requirement. The candle-coverage sub-gap is resolved.

conclusion: EXPLORATORY_ONLY / INCONCLUSIVE for inference. The 0-signal outcome of FVD-EXPLORATORY-002 is now attributed to candle coverage/exit-hour alignment: with data fetched through the exit hour, all 23 remaining candidate signals had complete entry/exit candles and 0 were dropped. The 50 earlier drops are a diagnostic artifact, not evidence about the economics of the mechanism. This run does not establish an edge, is not independently audited, and cannot promote or unlock the confirmatory track.
